attributes.action: Replace police Values-Based Interviews with mandatory local scenario testing.
attributes.additional_details: Current conversational recruitment filters allow biased or corrupt individuals to pass simply by memorising corporate scripts. Official data reveals that 4,877 officers voluntarily resigned in a single year, wasting millions in training costs. Testing operational capability under street pressure inside local facilities, like the Forest Gate Police Station, ensures resilience and strict financial accountability without adding any taxpayer costs.
attributes.background: Mandate UK police forces to permanently replace conversational Values-Based Interviews with mandatory, local high-pressure scenario testing. Candidates must prove operational capability, de-escalation skills, and emotional resilience under real-world street stress before being hired.

rejection.details:
We can only accept petitions about things the Government or Parliament are directly responsible for.

Decisions about recruitment are a matter for police forces and the College of Policing, not the UK Government or Parliament.
